title: 第十三章 修行第十四章 临近的危机
lines: 自来也沉吟不语，心中却已转换千百思虑。
小南和弥彦，资质上佳。经过三年教导后，若在继续苦修或是有所突破，将来的成就不下于现在的自己。
长门可称得上是天才中的天才，这般天赋自己平生仅见一人，便是大蛇丸，长门将来很有可能会成为绝代的强者。
但，若说长门是天才中的天才，那么夜天云的天赋只能用惊悚来形容。第一次便如此轻易的提取查克拉，根本闻所未闻。而且自来也注意到了一个事实--夜天云的查克拉十分精纯，丝毫不带一丝杂质。这就意味着在同等的查克拉量下，夜天云忍术的威力要强于常人许多。
自来也看着眼前四人，想到大蛤蟆仙人的预言，不知应是欢喜，还是担忧。
“记住，力量是用来保护同伴的。”自来也并不完全点破，但还是要警示下众人。
夜天云四人点了点头，满脸坚定的神色。
心中稍稍安心了一些，自来也道：“天云，提炼查克拉的时候有什么感觉？”
“没什么，就是觉得身体中有一股未知的能量，不过引导起来不是十分困难，只要心念一动，它便随了你的意愿。”夜天云心中略感疑惑自来也的问题，但仍旧如实作答。
自来也脑海中顿时闪过一个猜想：“天云，你试着破掉这个幻术。”话毕，自来也缓缓结印，印记并不复杂，自来也本不擅长幻术，因此对于幻术也只是略知皮毛而已。
“幻术。奈落见之术。”随着一声清吟，夜天云忽觉眼前情景一变，随即出现了让他难以忘怀的景色，他家中横遭不幸的那日情景。
奈落见之术可以引出被施术者内心的恐惧之景，不过夜天云心中一直告诉自己，不可被幻境迷惑。
夜天云全神贯注，一凝神，忽觉一股能量涌入脑海，顿时，眼前的景象又重回到了木屋之内。
“果然是精神力。”自来也印证了自己的猜想，不过却更加诧异，夜天云的精神力甚至已与自己相差无几。
精神力十分玄奥，可以通过修炼增加，但收效却微，大都是随着年龄的增长而增加。精神力强大的人会拥有强大的幻术抗性，而且，查克拉的控制力和纯度也会处在极高的阶级。
只是，精神力的修炼方法极为稀少，且均为不传之秘，如山中一族的秘术。同样，精神力先天强大的人也是凤毛麟角。
夜天云看着因思考而失神的自来也，心中也很是疑惑，他哪里知道，他的灵魂已是成年人，加上穿越了空间，强大无比，蕴含的精神力自然如同浩瀚汪洋一般深不可测。
意识到自己有些失态，自来也收起了心思，不过并未将精神力讲解给众人，现在来说还太过于玄奥了。
“今天是第一天，大家回去在温习下今日所学，早早休息吧，我去给大家打些野味。”修行之道，一张一弛，自来也深谙此道，适当的放松也是极为重要的。
听到这番话，众人也都十分高兴，弥彦更是叫了出来。欣喜过后，众人也都各自忙碌起来，打扫客厅，准备碗筷。不过，夜天云却是寻着自来也的身影跟了上去。
“天云，什么事？”自来也感到夜天云追上了自己的脚步，回过身，疑惑的问道。
“自来也老师，忍者除了苦无和手里剑以外没有别的武器了么？”
自来也一笑，便明白了夜天云的来意，不过仍旧是耐心的解释道：多数是用苦无和手里剑，不过还有忍刀、镰刀等其他的兵器。雨忍村的首领半藏的武器就是长链锁镰，而我的一个好友则是惯用忍者的短刀。”
“不过。。”自来也忽然顿了一下，继而接道：“你是想请教刀术吧。”见到对方点了点头，自来也将夜天云身后的刀抽了出来。
自来也凝视着手中的太刀，道：“好美的墨色太刀，从未见过，而且相对于普通的***略长数寸，天云，你曾说过这是你父母的遗物，你父母或是祖上是武士么？”
“算是吧。”夜天云淡淡的应了一句，心中正在盘算如何敷衍，不过好在自来也没有深究这个问题，而是继续问道：“那你学过刀术？”
“略懂皮毛。”
“嗯，我并不擅长刀术，不过我常常与我那个朋友相互切磋修行经验，也算是有些眼光，从旁指点下应该是绰绰有余。”
自来也算是侧面答应了夜天云的请求。
“明天开始，闲暇之余我来指点你刀术。”自来也做了个允诺，转身离去，而夜天云也回到屋中。
content_en:
Jiraiya was silent, but he had thousands of thoughts in his mind.
Konan and Yahiko have excellent qualifications. After three years of teaching, if you continue to practice hard or make breakthroughs, your future achievements will be no less than what you are now.
Nagato can be regarded as a genius among geniuses. He has only seen one person with such talent in his life, and that is Orochimaru. Nagato is likely to become an unparalleled strong man in the future.
However, if Nagato is a genius among geniuses, then Ye Tianyun's talent can only be described as terrifying. It was unheard of to extract chakra so easily for the first time. And Jiraiya also noticed the fact that Ye Tianyun's chakra was very pure, without any impurities. This means that with the same amount of chakra, the power of Ye Tianyun's ninjutsu is much stronger than that of ordinary people.
Jiraiya looked at the four people in front of him, thinking of the big toad sage's prediction, and didn't know whether he should be happy or worried.
"Remember, power is used to protect your companions." Jiraiya didn't completely point it out, but he still wanted to warn everyone.
Ye Tianyun and the others nodded with firm expressions on their faces.
Feeling a little more at ease, Jiraiya said, "Tianyun, how do you feel when you refine chakra?"
"Nothing, I just feel that there is an unknown energy in my body, but it is not very difficult to guide it. As long as your mind moves, it will follow your wishes." Ye Tianyun was slightly confused about Jiraiya's question, but still answered truthfully.
A conjecture suddenly flashed through Jiraiya's mind: "Tianyun, try to break this illusion." After speaking, Jiraiya slowly formed a seal. The mark was not complicated. Jiraiya was not good at illusion, so he only had a superficial knowledge of illusion.
"Illusion. The art of seeing Naraku." With a clear chant, Ye Tianyun suddenly felt that the scene in front of him changed, and then an unforgettable scene appeared, the scene of that day when his family suffered misfortune.
The art of Narakushin can bring out the fearful scene in the heart of the person who is being casted, but Ye Tianyun always told himself in his heart not to be confused by the illusion.
Ye Tianyun concentrated on it, and suddenly felt a surge of energy pouring into his mind. Suddenly, the scene in front of him returned to the wooden house.
"Sure enough, it's mental power." Jiraiya confirmed his suspicion, but he was even more surprised. Ye Tianyun's mental power was almost the same as his own.
Mental power is very mysterious and can be increased through practice, but the effect is minimal and most of it increases with age. People with strong mental power will have strong illusion resistance, and their chakra control and purity will be at an extremely high level.
However, spiritual power cultivation methods are extremely rare, and they are all secrets that are not passed down, such as the secret techniques of the mountain clan. Likewise, people with innately strong mental powers are rare.
Ye Tianyun looked at Jiraiya who was lost in thought, and he was also very confused. How did he know that his soul was already an adult, and it had traveled through space and was extremely powerful. The spiritual power contained in it was naturally as unfathomable as the vast ocean.
Realizing that he had lost his temper, Jiraiya stopped thinking, but he did not explain his mental power to everyone. It was too mysterious now.
"Today is the first day. Let's go back and review what we have learned today. Let's take a rest early. I will hunt some game for everyone." The way of practice is to relax. Jiraiya is well versed in this. Proper relaxation is also extremely important.
After hearing these words, everyone was very happy, and Yahiko even shouted out. After the joy, everyone got busy, cleaning the living room and preparing dishes. However, Ye Tianyun looked for Jiraiya and followed him.
"Tianyun, what's the matter?" Jiraiya felt Ye Tianyun catching up with him, turned around, and asked doubtfully.
"Jiraiya-sensei, do ninjas have no other weapons besides kunai and shurikens?"
Jiraiya smiled and understood Ye Tianyun's intention, but he still explained patiently: Most of them used kunai and shuriken, but there were also other weapons such as ninja swords and sickles. Hanzo, the leader of Rain Ninja Village, uses a long chain scythe as his weapon, while a good friend of mine uses a ninja's short sword. "
"but. . Jiraiya suddenly paused, and then continued: "You want to ask for advice on sword skills." "Seeing the other party nodding, Jiraiya pulled out the knife behind Ye Tianyun.
Jiraiya stared at the tachi in his hand and said: "What a beautiful black tachi, I have never seen it before, and it is a few inches longer than an ordinary sword. Tianyun, you once said that this is a relic of your parents. Are your parents or ancestors samurai?" "
"So be it. "Ye Tianyun responded lightly, thinking about how to deal with it. Fortunately, Jiraiya did not delve into this issue, but continued to ask: "Then you have learned sword skills? "
“Know a little bit about it. "
"Well, I'm not good at swordsmanship, but I often compare practice experiences with that friend of mine, and I have some insight. It should be more than enough to give some guidance. "
Jiraiya agreed to Ye Tianyun's request.
"Starting tomorrow, I will teach you how to use the sword in my spare time. "Jiraiya made a promise, turned around and left, and Ye Tianyun also returned to the house.
